title: BPW-2026-0516
text:
[JOINT REPORT(S)]
BPW-2026-0516
BOS + BCA
CD ALL
PERSONAL SERVICES CONTRACT – NS CORPORATION
Recommending the Board:
APPROVE and FORWARD this report with transmittals to the Mayor and City Council with the request that the Board of Public Works be authorized to execute a Personal Services Contract with NS Corporation for Repair and Maintenance Services for Automated Vehicle Wash Facilities; and
UPON the Mayor’s and Council’s authorization, the President or two members of the Board will execute the contract.
(W.O.: SRBCAOCC)
summary: Authorization for Board of Public Works to execute Personal Services Contract with NS Corporation for repair and maintenance of automated vehicle wash facilities.
